purpose: Pre-publication review of three existing technical articles in English and Korean

selection.recordedPerformance: Two impressions, no clicks for the legacy Spring Boot migration URL; no returned query rows for the three candidates. Latest dates may be provisional.
selection.interpretation: Insufficient query evidence to validate search demand. Selected for technical relevance and reproducibility, not demonstrated traffic opportunity.

independentAIReview.scope: Read-only review of six articles and two example checkers against primary sources; no execution by reviewer. Not a human or native-speaker review.

findings.issue: Default-locale numeric formatting made the fixed output locale-dependent.
findings.resolution: Use String.format(Locale.ROOT, ...) and test the standard example under default and ar/EG JVM locales.

findings.issue: Generic +json suffix acceptance exceeded the application/*+json sample contract.
findings.resolution: Require the application media type and add an eighth test rejecting text/example+json.

findings.issue: Korean reference to the last test became ambiguous after appending a case.
findings.resolution: Refer explicitly to the empty JSON body test.
findings.independentRecheck: not requested for the single phrase; author confirmed the corrected reference

webclient.source: Exact matching Java and Gradle blocks extracted from both articles
